name: Cress
description: A web-based app to map squiggles to MEI snippets

scripts.build: rm -rf dev/server/Cress-gh && webpack --config webpack.config.js && cp -R assets src/workers dev/server/Cress-gh
scripts.bundle:pages: rm -rf gh-pages/Cress/Cress-gh && webpack --config webpack.pages-config.js && cp -R assets src/workers gh-pages/Cress/Cress-gh
scripts.build:k8s: rm -rf dev/server/Cress-gh && webpack --config webpack.k8s-config.js && cp -R assets src/workers dev/server/Cress-gh
